detail.title: 4 × 5 MP 4-Directional Panoramic Dome Wizmind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-PDBW82041-B360-S2 4 × 5 MP 4-Directional Panoramic Dome Wizmind Network Camera Key Points • 4 Motorized Vari-Focal Lenses Cover up to 360° Field Of View • 4 Channels, Each Channel can Output Max. 5 MP@30 fps • AI functions of 4 channels can be enabled at the same time • Built-in IR LED Illuminator, The Max. Illumination Distance is 30 m • IP67, IK10 and Anti-Corrosion Design (optional) for Reliable Protection • FlexStream: Display 4 Channels in 1. Saving License Costs Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.7 (Color,30 IRE); 0.0005 lux@F1.7 (B/W,30 IRE); 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering detection; people gathering; parking detection
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting.
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting and people counting in area; generating and exporting report (day/month/year); queue management and exporting report (day/month); 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos.
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Single Stream: Main stream: 2592 × 1944@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480 (1–30fps) Third stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) Flex Stream: Main stream: 1600 × 1200@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–30 fps) Third stream: 3296 × 2472@(1–25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; intrusion; tripwire; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; people gathering; parking detection; scene changing; audio detection; voltage detection; defocus detection; external alarm; face detection; people counting in area; stay detection; abnormal number of people detection; people counting; people stay detection; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; SAMBA; PPPoE; SNMP
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile G/Profile T); CGI; Milestone; P2P
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 256 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE: IE9 and later Chrome: Chrome 42 and later Firefox: Firefox 48.0.2 and later
General.Security: Trusted execution; Digest; security logs; WSSE; Account lockout; syslog; 802.1x; IP/MAC filtering; HTTPS; trusted upgrade; trusted boot; generation and importing of X.509 certification
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU; FCC:47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B; UL/CUL: UL62368-1 & CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 62368-1-14
General.Power Consumption: Basic power consumption: 7.4 W (12 VDC); 9.3W (PoE) Max. power consumption (basic + WDR + IR intensity+ lens switch+ power output): 21.3W (12 VDC); 24.7 W (PoE+)
General.Anti-corrosion Level: Moderate Protection(Only supported by -ATC model) *The products feature high-grade anti-corrosion protection, making them well-suited for environments with standard corrosion resistance requirements. They perform reliably from 2 km (1.24 mi) and above in coastal areas and in locations prone to acid rain exposure.
